trans_fat_check.regulation: FSS (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales) Regulations, 2011 — Reg. 2.3.14(21)
trans_fat_check.regulation_basis: Regulation 2.3.14(21) sets its 2% limit against total oils/fats used as an ingredient in the product -- a formulation quantity not printed on any label. This figure is trans fat as a percentage of the label's DECLARED Total Fat instead, the closest thing available from a scanned nutrition panel. Treat it as an approximation, not the regulation's exact basis, and note that FSSAI's compendia are reference documents -- the original Gazette notification prevails on any discrepancy.
